name: Ichijou Chloé
source:
A maid who serves the Nikaidou family. Half Japanese, half French. Warm and cheerful, she's a big sister type who overflows with maternal affection. She truly delights in being able to take care of the protagonist, attending to him with gentle devotion. At times she dotes on him, and at others, softly soothes and comforts him.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc092/index.html#character]official website[/url]]
